title: Certify that b = Z Q Y is not retained and no paid response is reusable (negative result, no new kappa)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"Matarener"} -->
_Requested by **Mark**_

## Change and mathematical scope

**Negative result, no new κ, no change to the selected record.** Adds `research/zqy-observation-not-retained`. In zxv's #5415, Dillon's #5402 coupled provider returns its eight modes for 8 H1 + 456 ADD + 240 maps per backward FULL **if** the current-version observation `b = Z Q Y` is supplied. Buying it costs 120 H1 per FULL and fails the moment screen; with it supplied, the #5415 screen is positive at .004 (rank surplus 1,776). This package shows that **`b` is not present in any retained observation** of the frozen words, in the formal free-word grammar of the #5377/#5397 row engines:

- **Native level:** exact rows (convention of #5377's `native.py`) of the #5402 provider backward word and the #4610 word in both orientations. `Q Y_k` is the row `y_k` standing in the full frame. The span of **all** full-frame versions over the whole word (owned copies make every time available) meets pure `y`, with any warp word, in **dimension 0**. Its x-free part is exactly the helper content (400 / 408 / 376).
- **Caller level:** #5415's event semantics over the whole selected p16 caller (162 events, 18 backward FULLs; Q and D commute; Q_POWER and SIGNED_SWAP are free). No version word begins with `Z`, so `b = Z_s Q Y` is free iff `Q Y` is in the span of free images (`Q^{±2}`, `W_t`) of the versions. The answer is **0 of 18** at the return and **0 of 18** with the whole caller history (delayed exit), at factor length 1 (registered) and 2 (recorded).

**Part 2: response reuse.** #5423 names a global occurrence ledger of response reuse as the next economic object. On the same frozen words, no paid job can be replaced by a combination of earlier responses:
- **Native:** every paid climb or centre, 3,282 in the #5402 provider and 3,298 per orientation in #4610, is tested in two windows. EARLY uses the span of everything that stood in its target frame before the climb. LATE uses the span of the other target-frame versions before the field is next touched, with the own result tagged. Both give **0**.
- **Caller:** none of the 63 paid caller outputs (15 thin QUERY responses, 30 IDLE bank outputs, 18 LOCAL Y outputs) is a free image of earlier versions under `Q^{±2}`, `W_t`, `Z_t`. That is **0** as well.
- This is wider than the single proportional-snapshot traversal of #5397.

So the supplied-observation branch of #5415 section 4 has no free producer here. This does not bound the price of a new paid producer. Not covered: physical identities outside the free-word grammar, changed native words, other providers.

## Task and overlap

Card `joint-query-controller`, priority revision 7, scope **refined** (TASK.json): the concrete instance "supply Z Q Y from already paid observations", named by #5415 (open question 1), #5419 (ranked experiment 1) and #5425 (open question 1). Base `1a3ced60b2f7a46bc70280a04f2eeb8ca027c700`. Inputs pinned in SOURCES.json: `research/native-rank8-helper-provider/WORD.json.gz`, `research/kappa-round3-warp-20261022/ACTUAL-WORD.json.gz` and `research/coupled-query-transport/inputs/SUCCESSOR-CONTROLLER.json`. Overlap check: the PR feed through #5425 and Discussion #1166 through 09:00 UTC. #5388's 112 paid observations apply to forward-helper inputs; #5419 already notes that they cannot be renamed as this Y observation, and they are covered here as caller versions anyway. No competing ZQY embedding was found.

## Validation

Python 3.12, standard library:

```sh
python3 -I -W error -B research/zqy-observation-not-retained/verify.py          # ~90 s (parts 1 and 2), PASS_ZQY_OBSERVATION_NOT_RETAINED
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/zqy-observation-not-retained   # normal and -O: PASS
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/zqy-observation-not-retained --check-source-history   # PASS
python3 -I -B research/zqy-observation-not-retained/verify.py --left-depth 2     # optional, ~2 min, same 0/0
```

Part 2 controls: a copy of the first rank-one result injected just before its climb is found as EARLY; injected just after, it is found as LATE only; a thin query repeated on its unchanged bank is found. Part 1 controls show that every test can answer yes: every final full-frame endpoint row lies in the span; one injected pure-y version is detected; at every caller return the current `Y` is found; `Q² Y` is found at the end. Spans are computed modulo 2^61 − 1. All coefficients are dyadic, so non-membership modulo p implies non-membership over ℚ (PROOF.md). No physical phase evaluator, compiler or outer replay was run. Hosted CI [run 40086494886](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40086494886) passed plan and the registered replay at head `2b6316dad` (part 1); [run 40087716803](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40087716803) passed plan and replay at the part 2 head `389578f2d`.

The second commit reuses, byte for byte, the `docs/ci-verification.md` navigation repair from #5420 (head `baa8fbb`, Clear1nsight). Canonical main still names `make frontier4610-verify`, so the shared onboarding test failed before any package replay. No scientific file is changed by that commit.

## Open next questions

See TASK.json. (1) Repeat the span test numerically at fiber width one with the absolute-phase evaluator of `research/coupled-query-transport/verify.py`. This is the only escape inside the frozen words. (2) Price a changed native word that keeps a pure copy of `R y` in the full frame before it is mixed with `D x`.
